# Jenasaro

Jenasaro is construction production management software for connecting project scheduling with Lean production control and field execution.

Canonical website: https://jenasaro.com/

## Core topics
- Lean construction software: https://jenasaro.com/lean-construction-software.html
- Construction scheduling software: https://jenasaro.com/construction-scheduling-software.html
- Last Planner System workflows: https://jenasaro.com/last-planner-system.html
- Takt planning: https://jenasaro.com/takt-planning.html
- PPC and production control: https://jenasaro.com/ppc-production-control.html
- Construction constraint management: https://jenasaro.com/constraint-management.html
- Primavera P6 production planning: https://jenasaro.com/primavera-p6.html

## Platform capabilities
Jenasaro connects schedule logic and baselines, look-ahead and make-ready planning, daily commitments, Percent Plan Complete, reasons for non-completion, constraint ownership, takt and workfront planning, team capacity, Primavera P6 import, drawing-based planning and management reporting.

Product enquiries: https://jenasaro.com/interest.html
